newsitem.title: USA: Illinois Gov using campaign fund to promote school.
newsitem.headline: Illinois Gov using campaign fund to promote school.

text.p: Illinois Gov. Jim Edgar has dipped into his campaign warchest to fund part of a $600,000 advertising push for his school funding proposal.
Edgar unveiled two television spots on Sunday to be aired statewide for the next three weeks.
The Illinois Education Association and the Civic Committee of the Commercial Club have also kicked in money for the campaign.

Edgar made school funding reforms a centerpiece of his state-of-the-state address earlier this year and has proposed increasing state support to provide at least $1 billion in property tax relief at the local level.
